Anna Bondár (born 27 May 1997) is a Hungarian professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of No. 50 by the WTA , achieved on 18 July 2022 and a best doubles ranking of No. 43, reached on 30 January 2023. She is currently the No. 1 singles player from Hungary. Playing for Hungary in Billie Jean King Cup, Bondár has a win–loss record of 16–9 (as of October 2024). Career [ edit ] 2021: WTA 125 title, top 100 debut [ edit ] The 2021 season was one of progress for Bondár. In July in Gdynia , at the Poland Open , she reached her first WTA Tour -level quarterfinal also recording her first two wins on the tour. [ 1 ] Starting early September, she had a series of good results. The first step was the 60k Collonge-Bellerive tournament where she reached semifinal defeating all her opponents in straight sets.
